_comment: Branching upgrades, keyed by tower. Each tower has a list of tiers; a tier unlocks once the tower reaches `tier` and stays pending until the player picks one option. `mult` multiplies a stat, `add` is additive (integers like chain_count), `override` replaces a value outright, and `flags` grant new mechanics the sim understands. See docs/DESIGN.md.

_flags.crit_chance: 0..1 chance a hit deals crit_mult times damage
_flags.execute_below: instant kills an enemy under this fraction of max hp
_flags.burn_dps: damage per second applied after the hit (fire type, respects armour)
_flags.burn_stacks: how many burns can stack on one enemy
_flags.armor_shred: flat armour removed from the target for armor_shred_duration
_flags.bounty_mult: coin multiplier when this tower lands the killing blow
_flags.true_damage: 1 = this tower's hits ignore armour entirely
_flags.pierce: extra enemies a projectile can pass through
